newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates trade lower, close steady.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates trade lower, close steady.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates were unchanged at Friday's closing from Thursday, but they had traded at slightly lower levels as the demand for funds weakened, dealers said.
The overnight money traded between 20.875 and 21 percent and finished at 21 percent.
Traders said the rates changed only a shade and were not expected to move much further down until the end of the last day of the two-week reserve period on Wednesday.
"The number of borrowers is decreasing," Adam Szilagyi of ABN-Amro Bank said. "Funds are going into (one-month and one-week) reverse repo and some banks may have overfilled the reserves."
Dealers said the demand for money would probably weaken further slightly at the end of the reserve period, as usual, but the overnight rates were unlikely to drop below 20.5 percent.
"On Tuesday or Wednesday (the rates) will perhaps go down a little, about 0.5 percent," said Postabank's Karoly Barath. "Just because they usually do that."
